title: Supplying a greeting argument
description: You can use one function body with two names.

steps.description: name is the parameter, a placeholder in the function definition. You use its value in the greeting's print call.
The first call supplies the argument Ada. Inside that call, name refers to Ada.

steps.question: Which name will the second greeting include?
steps.answer: It includes Grace because the second call supplies Grace as its argument.

steps.description: You see a greeting for Ada followed by a greeting for Grace. Each call runs the same body with its own supplied name.
